description: Market regime (trend, volatility, RSI, ATR%) and nearest support/resistance for BTC and ETH only, refreshed every 15 minutes (free). Returns {price, regime, nearestSupport, nearestResistance}. Pick this over the paid siblings when you just need a quick read on BTC/ETH; use get_signal_bias ($0.01) for a trade direction, get_trade_plan ($0.03) for full setup levels and odds, or get_market_regime/get_support_resistance ($0.005 each) for other symbols or deeper history.
name: get_free_snapshot
